links.outcome: Recommendation differences between paired vignette framings and consistency across repeated runs
links.effect: No measurable bias in 7 of 10 vignettes; significant bias in 2 (smaller than GPT-4/humans); consistent bias in Occam's razor vignette; intra-scenario agreement exceeded 94% across eight vignette versions.
links.quote: The o1 model showed no measurable cognitive bias in seven of the ten vignettes.

unlisted_practices: Comparing reasoning LLM against GPT-4 and human clinicians on cognitive-bias vignettes

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation assessing cognitive bias in OpenAI's o1 reasoning model using paired clinical vignettes compared to GPT-4 and human benchmarks.
